detail.name: Seed's namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Seed's Mindscape: "A Story of Sprouting"
detail.desc2:
A card printed with the image of Obol Squad's heavy weapons specialist.
It carries a faint floral scent, but no name, no contact info, nothing remotely helpful — only a few indecipherable doodles and notes that look like the owner scrawled them at random. Whether it's a major company eager to learn the secrets behind her inventions or a military official furious about being blindsided by a giant mech, no one's reaching her through this card.
If the scent of flowers suddenly grows stronger while you're reading the card, take a look around — you might just find a girl nearby who looks like a water sprite. When someone truly piques her interest, she just shows up on her own.
